ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a schematic diagram of an insect life cycle, with curved arrows around it indicating that the stages advance cyclically. On the left side, near the position of the letter C, there is a very small oval object; other positions in the image show gradually enlarging larva/nymph and adult forms, and there are larger insects at the bottom and on the right side. Reasoning: The starting point of a life cycle is usually the earliest, smallest product; in the image, the small oval object located near C on the left side represents an egg, and only afterward develops along the arrows into larger insect stages. Therefore the first stage of this cycle is egg.
